key_insight: dR-Eig-PIELM removes represented gradient modes before the Maxwell eigensolve, preventing the gradient contamination that PEC boundary conditions alone cannot eliminate.
engineering_relevance: The method supports waveguide spectral analysis and geometry design using computed cutoff frequencies and sensitivities.
method: Build compatible tensor-product gradient–curl trial spaces.
Restrict the sampled PEC space to the mass-orthogonal complement of represented gradients.
Assemble symmetric weak-form Gram matrices for a one-shot, multimode reduced eigensolve.
evidence_signal: The paper establishes fixed-degree exactness for rectangles and cuboids; numerical tests show exclusion of gradient-contaminated spurious modes, rapid degree convergence, and competitive work–precision performance.
watch_item: The symmetric-definite formulation depends on the stated sampling and material-positivity assumptions; the mapped-waveguide example illustrates potential rather than broad geometry validation.
paper_title: Embedding a de Rham Complex Structure into Eig-PIELM for Maxwell Eigenvalue Problems
